description: The reservoir flood-operation model compares five pre-release methods for Seomjingang Reservoir and supplies a GUI with operational information for South Korean multipurpose reservoirs. Outputs include hourly decision graphs and tables. This resource is provided by Sooyeon Yi; Eunkyung Lee; Jungwon Ji and coauthors. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Transfer elsewhere requires local operating information; the study does not establish real-time adoption. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
